build_notes: Compile tests/fixture.cu and tests/faults.cu against the SDK include norm.cuh, tests/fixture-api.h, the candidate normalization object, the host-Goose C object and the accepted DSOs.
The fixture and the native oracle must be compiled with identical floating-point contraction flags so identical source expressions round identically.

fixture.3: failed requirement (bit-exact mismatch, guard/padding corruption, witness violation); the failing case and the first differing element are printed to stderr

faults.0: case 0 control: valid native norm completed without abort
faults.81: malformed input rejected through ggml_abort (expected for cases 1-15)

witness.rollback_GGML_GOOSE_CUDA_NORM_0: host==0 and all three device words==0
witness.legacy_GGML_GOOSE_RMS_0: host==0xC3, mode_mask==0xC3, mul_add_scale_mask==0; vector_flag_mask intentionally unchecked because RMS modes bypass the Goose path entirely

provenance: The reference kernels in tests/fixture.cu are an independent re-emission of the arithmetic of inputs/native-norm.cu with exactly one deliberate change: destination addressing (and, for rms_norm_back, the forward-source addressing) uses explicit element strides instead of the packed contiguous layout assumed by the originals. They never call or link candidate code. On contiguous layouts they are expected to be bit-identical to the native oracle; on padded layouts they define the corrected strided semantics required by the contract. Reference launch configurations come from a host-side mirror of the contract launch policy, so a candidate that dispatches differently fails the bitwise comparison.
comparison_policy: Bit-exact 32-bit comparisons on ordinary finite patterns; no tolerances anywhere. The native oracle is used wherever its semantics are valid (it reads sources through their real strides in all modes and writes packed destinations). Padded-destination and strided-backward cases are proven against the independent reference; the native packed twin is additionally compared where the reduction path is provably identical (16-byte-aligned padding, or modes 0/1/6/7 which have no vector path) and recorded informationally otherwise. NaN handling follows a documented policy: the affected row must be entirely NaN while all other rows stay bit-exact; NaN payload equality is intentionally not asserted.

case_families.name: unary_contiguous_tiers
case_families.description: cols 61/64/132/520/1023/1024/2052 over [cols,2,2,1]; scalar bs32/bs256/bs1024 boundaries and rms vector eligibility boundaries

case_families.name: rms_vector_extremes
case_families.description: cols 8192 (vpt4 tier) and 16388 (n4>4096 falls back to scalar bs1024)

case_families.name: strided_source
case_families.description: padded outer source strides: 16B-aligned padding keeping the vector path, misaligned padding forcing scalar, channel-level padding, and a legal stride-0 channel broadcast

case_families.name: strided_destination_reference
case_families.comparison: reference plus native packed twin where paths align
case_families.description: padded outer destination strides; the rms 4B-padding case is order-divergent by design (candidate scalar vs native vector) and recorded as informational native divergence

case_families.name: fused_mul_m3
case_families.comparison: native_exact plus reference for the padded destination
case_families.description: full/row/col/channel/scalar broadcasts, swapped operand position, 16B operand padding, misaligned operand base, vector bs128 and scalar tiers, intermediate canary, operand aliasing the fused output, padded destination

case_families.name: fused_mul_add_m5
case_families.comparison: native_exact plus reference for the padded destination
case_families.description: same matrix plus the mul intermediate kept data=NULL (never materialized) and add-source aliasing

case_families.name: fused_scale_m4
case_families.comparison: native_exact plus reference for the padded destination
case_families.description: scale positive/negative/zero, eps=0, vector/scalar tiers, padded destination, intermediate canary

case_families.name: group_norm_m1
case_families.description: basic, bs1024 boundary (group size 1024), partial final group keeping the native group-size denominator ([3,1,3,1] groups=2), empty tail block, groups==channels, eps=0, all-zero group

case_families.name: rms_back_m6
case_families.comparison: native_exact contiguous; reference plus informational native divergence for strided source/destination
case_families.description: cols 64/61/1024, eps=0, and strided source/destination/both; the upstream kernel reads the forward source and writes the destination with flat packed addressing, so strided cases record native divergence

case_families.name: special_finite
case_families.comparison: native_exact; NaN policy for two cases
case_families.description: exact-representable specials, finite overflow-to-zero (modes 2/7), all-zero rows/groups with positive eps, eps=0 with strictly positive variance, grid clamp at 65537 channels (mode 0) and samples (mode 2), NaN policy rows (modes 0/2)

case_families.name: alias
case_families.description: unary in-place (destination aliases the source buffer); fused operand aliasing is covered inside the m3/m5 families

fault_cases.description: valid native norm must not abort
fused mul node does not reference the rms node
scale node src[0] is not the rms node
fused add node does not reference the mul node
negative epsilon on the fused path

gaps: NaN payload bit-level equality is intentionally not asserted; the policy check covers NaN presence plus bit-exact non-NaN rows
grid clamp is exercised for the channel dimension (mode 0) and the sample dimension (mode 2); the row dimension is not clamped upstream and has no case
block-size selection is verified indirectly through numeric path conformance and the witness vector flag; block size itself is not observable without timing or introspection
fused operand padding covers the row stride (nb1) only; nb2/nb3 operand padding is not covered
aliasing where the forward source X aliases the fused output buffer is not covered (unary in-place and operand alias are)
under GGML_GOOSE_RMS=0 the vector-flag witness word is intentionally unchecked; host and mode-mask words are still asserted
single CUDA device only; HIP/MUSA and multi-GPU are out of scope for this fixture
the suite was not executed locally; compilation and GPU execution are parent responsibilities
parent_corrections: See correctness-findings.json;runtime flags in RMS reference replaced by compile-time fusion flags. Fixture init is synchronized with default stream before nonblocking compute. Old-native fallback skips corrected-stride cases.
